Try these activities as a student, then borrow an idea for your teaching.
Each starts with something to finish or improve. Choose a topic below, edit an
answer and ask for feedback. For code or mathematics, use **Check** or **Run**
to see what your work does.

With **Copy prompt**, Feedback prepares a message to paste into an AI chat you
already use. If your course has arranged feedback directly on this page, use
those settings instead. For image activities, attach the picture in your chat too.

The **For course authors** notes suggest ways to use each activity. Open the
source beneath it when you want to make a version for your own students.
